objs.name: document
objs.description: Main managed policy or guideline document with versions, metadata, content, release status, validity, distribution, and archive handling.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Selected type such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Default name composed of abbreviation, consecutive number per type, and title.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Workflow or lifecycle status such as editing, released, or out of force.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released document validity starts.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid from and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which validity must be checked.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration after overriding before physical deletion.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification used for structuring documents and defining templates and validity/archive periods.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation included in document names.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for documents of the type before a validity check is required.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Archive period for documents of the type.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template selectable when creating a new document object for a document type.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document, released and archived with the main document and subject to versioning.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the main document release cycle and released or published directly via properties.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person participating as creator, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader, initiator, or acknowledgement recipient.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used for reader, author, reviewer, releaser, archive, business admin, or distribution assignment.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for a document and managed without directly affecting the document content or version history until scheduled.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document before validity expires and processed by workflow.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request created to invalidate and archive a released document.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants for release, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement processing.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature documented for workflow participants for a released version.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups or persons assigned to a document for email distribution or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation requested from distribution recipients for a released document version.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which a document can be specified as visible or not.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting the document type.

evts.name: edit_property
evts.description: Document properties and metadata are maintained automatically or by the user.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Document content is edited with the editing client in a local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: The document is saved after editing.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The saved document is automatically converted to PDF by the system.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Group-related and person-related authorizations and workflow participants are assigned in document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is added to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is released directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is published directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is deleted directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is added to a document as a controlled document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is changed.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with the next released version of the main document.

evts.name: create_version
evts.description: A new document version is created automatically for released-document revision, attachment changes, scheduled change proposals, or reactivation.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The approval process for a document is initiated after creation, maintenance, and control definition.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: The registered author signs the creation step of the release workflow.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Assigned reviewers complete the review task for the document.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Assigned releaser completes the release task and the document is finally released.

evts.name: reject_workflow
evts.description: A rejection during review or release cancels the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author-rights user creates a change proposal for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation and creates a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: The document author documents editing of assigned change proposals.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: A completed change proposal is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system creates a request for validity extension 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Additional validity is declared and the document remains valid in its current version with updated valid-until date.

evts.name: delete_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The request for validity extension is deleted after validity extension or termination by new version release or override.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request for override for a selected document.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: The document and attachments are declared out of force, authorizations are revoked except for the archive group, and archiving begins.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Existing edited versions are deleted after override.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period has expired, documents are physically deleted.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A business admin group user creates a request for reactivation and selects the document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document and archived attachments are reactivated and authorizations restored from maintained attributes.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups or persons are assigned to a document for email distribution or acknowledgement.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Assigned users and user-group members are informed by email when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Persons and user-group members on the acknowledgement distribution list are requested by email to confirm acknowledgement after release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of the released document version.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: The translated version is checked with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated language version is released and becomes visible in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: For a document in a multi-client system, clients are specified in which the document is visible or not.

o2o.description: A document has a selected document type.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
Attachments are associated with a main document.
Additional information is associated with a document.
Users can be assigned to a document as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader, creator, or initiator.
User groups can be assigned to documents for authorizations and reader access.
A change proposal clearly belongs to a document.
A validity extension request is linked to the document to be checked.
An override request is created for a selected document.
A reactivation request selects the corresponding document for reactivation.
Users are assigned to user groups.
Distribution lists can be maintained for each document.
Persons can be assigned to a distribution list.
User groups can be assigned to a distribution list.
Acknowledgements are confirmations for the current document version.
Distribution recipients confirm acknowledgements.
A document can be specified as visible or not in clients.
Workflow tasks are assigned to involved users.
Workflow participants provide electronic signatures.
Signatures are documented for each released document version.
